title: Taiwanese Student Business Association
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Business Association (TSBA) is a student organization at the UCLA Anderson School of Management. It is dedicated to enhancing the study experience of students with a Taiwanese background or those interested in Taiwanese culture, with a mission to serve as a cultural exchange hub and to promote meaningful dialogue between cultures. TSBA is listed as an active identity club on the Anderson school’s official clubs and associations directory.

Beyond cultural programming, TSBA also supports its members’ professional development by connecting them with Taiwanese companies that have a presence in North America and with startup resources from Taiwan. The organization participates in annual AAPI Heritage Month programming and hosts hands-on cultural events. As of 2026, TSBA’s incoming co-presidents were listed by name on the Anderson school’s website, indicating active leadership succession.
